description: A benign marker containing the characters ' " < > was reflected verbatim (unescaped) in the response for parameter 'q', indicating the value is not contextually output-encoded. This is very likely exploitable as reflected cross-site scripting. No executable payload was sent — only structural characters — so manual confirmation of the injection context is recommended.
remediation: Apply contextual output encoding for the reflection context (HTML body, attribute, JS, URL) and add a restrictive Content-Security-Policy.
title: Reflected XSS: parameter 'q' reflects input unescaped
